text:
kelly: Hey team — planning to add a set of runtime + infra metrics to the Console dashboards. Need quick sync on RBAC + sharing: who can see raw telemetry vs aggregated customer views? @dheeraj @sasha :eyes:

dheeraj: quick q — do we need per-request stacks in customer-facing views? compliance likely says no PII. I think aggregated/sampled only.

sasha: Agree. Internal dashboards need kernel, kv/cache, batch traces to debug perf. Customer views should be limited to route+model+region + sampled token stats.

ana: (typo fixed) ana: also product ask — support needs a way to share snapshots with customers (read-only link). Must be auditable and time-limited.

maria: Audit + retention: log every dashboard share (actor, time, scope, IP). Default retention 1y. External shares >1 week require approval flow.

kelly: Draft RBAC mapping (sketch):
```
roles:
 - infra_viewer       # internal, full telemetry (kernel/cache traces)
 - infra_admin        # internal, full + edit dashboards
 - product_analyst    # internal, metrics + aggregates, no raw request bodies
 - support_agent      # internal, redacted request ids, search by case id
 - customer_readonly  # external, aggregated, per-org scoped
 - external_shared_link # token-based, auditable, expires
```

tim: Implementation idea: wire JWT scopes from APIGW -> Console enforces view filters. Add a filter pipeline to strip/hide KV/cache traces for non-infra roles.

dheeraj: Runtime telemetry needed (per-request): kernel_name, batch_size, kv_hit, sequence_length, tokens_generated, model_variant, request_latency. Infra needs gpu_util, queue_depth, alloc_id, process_restarts.

sasha: +1. Also add prefix_cache_hit_rate and avg_batch_latency. Those are the most actionable for perf ops.

ana: (ana) UX note: default dashboards should show an "Internal only" toggle and a "Create customer snapshot" button that automatically obfuscates controlled fields. Snapshot flow should surface what is redacted.

maria: For customer snapshots, require requester identity and purpose. Snapshot creation limited to Account Admin + Security approval for customers flagged as high-sensitivity.

kelly: Storage notes: snapshots go to S3 with SSE-KMS, indexed in audit DB (append-only). Retention configurable per org but default 1y. Export endpoints for compliance requests.

dheeraj: Open question: expose sampled raw logs to canary customers via contract? Suggest two modes: sampled raw (explicit customer opt-in + DPA) or aggregated-only.

sasha: Ops ask: add a toggle to redact prompt text by default for non-infra roles. Redaction should be reversible only by infra_admin via audited request.

ana: Action items:
 - @dheeraj to publish required telemetry schema (event fields + types) by EOD Wed (1760863600)
 - @sasha to prototype dashboard filter + redaction flow and mock API (PR next week)
 - @maria to draft audit retention + approval checklist and share with legal
 - @kelly to update product spec and upload UI mocks to Figma

maria: +1. I'll loop in legal on retention windows and external share wording.

dheeraj: I'll add infra work item to backlog with example event JSON and wireframe for scope filters.

kelly: If no objections I'll open an RFC in #eng-platform-docs tomorrow. Please flag anything I missed. :+1:

deploy-bot: deploy scheduled: draft/rbac-dashboard-spec -> staging at 1760861899

sasha: :thumbsup:

kelly: Thanks everyone — will follow up with RFC + calendar invite for a short sync if needed.
